topics.label: Introduction and Lecture Overview
topics.groupedBecause: The lecture opens with a welcome, an overview of the lecture themes, and the intended learning outcomes.

topics.label: Cell-Intrinsic Genetic and Epigenetic Mechanisms in Cancer Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how cell-intrinsic alterations modify cellular competence and drive clonal expansion during neoplastic development.

topics.label: Cell of Origin and Stem Cell Hierarchies in Cancer Initiation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how tissue differentiation hierarchies and the stemness properties of the cell of origin determine tumor initiation potential.

topics.label: Microenvironmental Signals, Inflammation, and Stromal Support
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics demonstrate how extrinsic microenvironmental cues, inflammatory signals, and supportive stroma promote tumor formation and sustain cancer growth.

topics.label: Technologies for Investigating Tumor Heterogeneity and Microenvironments
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic reviews the experimental and computational technologies used to profile single-cell genetics, cellular plasticity, and spatial microenvironments in tumors.

topics.label: Summary of Multi-Factorial Cancer Evolution and Conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics synthesize the multi-factorial evolutionary framework of cancer and provide concluding remarks for the lecture.
